dangerText: Aliens here are Infected: much stronger, but they pay much more. There are no safe zones, not even at the gates. When you arrive you have a few seconds before they notice you, unless you open fire.
packsText: Aliens live in nests: hit one and the whole nest attacks. Stalkers roam the sector and keep chasing you, and fighting draws them in. Keep moving and take one nest at a time.
lootText: Every kill also fills your expedition loot. Leave the Abyss through a gate to bank it. If your ship is destroyed, the loot is lost.
squadText: Hunting in a squad earns each of you more than hunting alone, but only pilots who really fight count. Invite pilots from the Squad window.
